repository.name: MLX-Reason-CT
repository.summary: Reimplements NVIDIA NV-Reason-CT's Primus 3D encoder, multimodal projector and Qwen3.5 hybrid language decoder in native MLX/Metal; replaces the Transformers/MONAI inference stack with local processing, explicit precision profiles and a standalone runner.

upstream_sources.name: NVIDIA NV-Reason-CT model materials
upstream_sources.revision_basis: Pinned model-source revision in conversion code and third-party notices.

upstream_sources.name: Transformers Qwen3.5 semantics
upstream_sources.revision_basis: Documented package-version reference, not a source commit.

upstream_sources.name: MLX-LM recurrent kernel
upstream_sources.revision_basis: Documented published-wheel version; gated_delta.py described as copied verbatim.

upstream_sources.name: PyTorch CUDA arithmetic reference
upstream_sources.revision_basis: PyTorch 2.13.0 source revision in third-party notices.

changes.original_behavior: Source checkpoint stores BF16 tensors in a monolithic safetensors file, including tied token embeddings/LM head and unused visual parameters.
changes.mlx_behavior: Memory-map BF16 storage and expand bits losslessly to FP32; retain source names/layouts, partition into vision/embedding/norm/32 decoder shards, verify tied head equality, and omit unused 2D visual/mask-token/head aliases.
changes.rationale: Bound host conversion memory and avoid duplicate or unused inference parameters.

changes.original_behavior: Upstream learned materials are BF16 and source execution has CUDA/ATen cast, reduction and cache boundaries.
changes.mlx_behavior: Default inference is FP32; expose source BF16 arithmetic and a separate BF16-storage/FP32-accumulation profile. Source-BF16 uses dedicated projection, normalization, activation and attention arithmetic instead of assuming generic MLX BF16 operations are equivalent.
changes.rationale: Make arithmetic changes explicit while preserving source boundaries in the reproduction profile.

changes.original_behavior: Primus applies nonoverlapping 8-cubed Conv3d patch embedding, EVA attention and a multimodal merger to a 192-cubed CT.
changes.mlx_behavior: Express patch convolution as reshape/transpose plus a flattened 864-by-512 projection; execute 16 EVA blocks and merger in MLX, retaining 13,824 tokens, 3-axis rotary geometry and learned weights.
changes.rationale: Nonoverlapping source convolution is algebraically a flattened patch projection.

changes.original_behavior: Source full attention and feed-forward computations span long CT token sequences.
changes.mlx_behavior: Chunk FP32 attention queries in groups of 256 and vision MLP tokens in groups of 512, with explicit mx.eval at staged boundaries; dedicated BF16 source attention kernels retain source arithmetic.
changes.rationale: Bound materialized score and feed-forward workspaces.

changes.original_behavior: Qwen3.5 alternates full-attention KV state with gated-delta linear-attention convolution/recurrent state.
changes.mlx_behavior: Implement request-owned DecoderCache per 32 layers; concatenate full-attention K/V, keep three convolution-history positions, use chunk_delta for prefill and Metal recurrence for single tokens. Cast recurrent cache to BF16 only in source_bfloat16; float32 and bfloat16 storage/FP32 accumulation profiles retain FP32 recurrent state.
changes.rationale: Reproduce hybrid cache semantics without Transformers or a host recurrent backend.

changes.original_behavior: Pinned upstream tokenizer/template and 3D MRoPE policy construct the CT conversation.
changes.mlx_behavior: Load tokenizer.json with tokenizers and the original Jinja template in a sandboxed environment; expand the single image marker into the full 3D grid and compute volume positions in NumPy. History attaches the CT once and replays final answers.
changes.rationale: Keep token/template semantics offline without importing Transformers.

changes.original_behavior: Source processor uses physical spacing, anatomical cropping, air padding and HU scaling before its 3D encoder.
changes.mlx_behavior: Reimplement the host stage with nibabel/SciPy: orient to LPS, linear affine resampling to configured spacing, pad with -1000 HU, select anatomical or centered crop, clip to +/-1000 and transpose to CZYX; retain crop geometry explicitly.
changes.rationale: Host geometry preparation is distinct from learned Metal execution.

changes.original_behavior: Upstream generation consumes CT embeddings and uses the configured EOS token set.
changes.mlx_behavior: Replace framework generation with an explicit greedy MLX loop, insert image embeddings into token embeddings, track hybrid-cache bytes/growth, stop on EOS or the token limit, and expose completion/truncation metrics.

changes.original_behavior: Upstream produces generated response text, optionally containing reasoning and answer markup.
changes.mlx_behavior: Add file-based report/JSON/run outputs and MedMLX discovery; split reasoning at </think>, strip only a trailing empty answer element, preserve partial output and raise on empty or non-EOS completion.
changes.rationale: Make completion and durable output behavior explicit for local application use.

preserved_behavior: Pinned model parameters are converted without retraining; source tensor layouts remain visible.
Primus token grid, multimodal projection, hybrid decoder topology, tokenizer, chat template, EOS set and source 3D position conventions are retained.
Source-BF16 is an explicit arithmetic profile; FP32 defaults are a declared arithmetic change.

findings: Repository documents analytic/storage reference tests plus recurrence/precision/cache tests.
Documented short synthetic source-BF16 run matched recorded vision/hidden boundaries and passed stated source-logit gates; subsequent attention optimization preserved recorded outputs.
Read current checkout; no uncommitted files reported by git status at inspection.
limits: No tests or inference were executed for this mapping.

Recorded full-model optimization uses one short-response synthetic case; the longer original-BF16 qualification matrix remains incomplete.
